title: Broaden LDBC full test-data coverage through Q13 and Short Query 6 frontiers

steps.step: Continue from BENCHPROD-106 bounded Q1/Q14 prefix40 evidence into broader full test-data LDBC paths
Cover the Query 13 recursive shape that uses array_append(path, p2) and p2 <> ALL(path)
Diagnose Short Query 6 returning zero rows for JDBC prepared execution
Resolve placeholders inside final grouped aggregate projections such as coalesce(min(parent), $2)
Add SQ6 regressions for literal, prepared, post-to-message derivation, and COPY empty-field NULL handling
Run Rust regressions, release PgWire integration tests, release build, JDBC probe, and disable-Q14 full test-data LDBC isolation smoke

evidence.jdbc_sq6_probe: PreparedStatement#setLong SQ6 probe against old run WAL copy moved from ROWS=0 before the fix to ROWS=1 after the fix

result.current_frontier: With Q14 disabled, the full test-data isolation run completes ldbc_command successfully and exercises Q13 plus all short queries 1-7. Non-isolation full test-data remains blocked by Query 14 timeout/performance and is not a full native LDBC pass.

remaining_blockers: This is disable-Q14 full test-data isolation evidence, not a full official/native LDBC benchmark pass.
Unbounded/non-isolation full test-data LDBC still has a Query 14 timeout/performance frontier.
LDBC update query files remain absent in the configured PostgreSQL implementation command path and are not covered by this read-focused run.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-108 candidate: attack non-isolation full test-data Q14 timeout/performance or add a targeted Q14 profiling harness while preserving evidence labels.
